items.title: Danny Boyle Shares Why He Used AI for Maggie Thatcher in ‘Ink’ – Without Asking Her Estate and His Love for ‘Obsession’ and ‘Backrooms’
items.excerpt: During a London Film Festival chat, the filmmaker also recalled his “uneventful” meeting with Rupert Murdoch after his ‘Slumdog Millionaire’ made the mogul’s studio “a lot of money.”

items.title: Nikon microscopic video competition winner disqualified for using generative AI
items.excerpt: Nikon says it’s revisiting its competition rules after the original winner’s video was too good to be true.

items.title: Claude can now turn data into animated explainers.
items.excerpt: Anthropic's Claude can now add motion to its output, generating 30-second video explainers, animated charts and product walkthroughs (Claude Motion); Runway and Luma both shipped hand-off integrations the same day.

items.excerpt: Two science-fiction series produced with generative AI, 'Space Nation' and 'Kira,' will have the world premieres of their pilot episodes at Mipcom.

items.title: AI-Assisted Animated K-Drama ‘The Painted Soul’ From ‘Mouse’ Director Sets Rakuten Viki Launch (EXCLUSIVE)

items.title: Brad Bird’s ‘Ray Gunn,’ ‘Toy Story 5’ and Roger Deakins Lead View Conference Lineup as AI Debate Takes Center Stage

items.title: Did Royal Mail Revive BBC & 'Paddington' Voiceover Star With AI?

items.title: BBC Staff Concerned About Matt Brittin Praise For AI 'Doctor Who'
